outputs.name: kenergy
outputs.basis: the final kinetic energy (the program's own reduction over all particles) relative to the CPU reference's. Upstream's check fabsf(kenergy_ - ref_kenergy_) < 1e-3f (common/GSimulationReference.hpp:105) is 1 f32 ulp at n16000 and bit equality at n32000/n64000 and fails 16 to 29 of 38 legitimate reimplementations; relative 1e-4, measured 2026-10-28 (README "Validation"; legitimate reductions <= 1.0e-5, the energy summed over half the particles 0.5, from the previous step's velocities 0.2, a 0.1% wrong time step 2.2e-3 to 3.1e-3)

outputs.name: pos
outputs.basis: not compared by upstream; the final positions within 1e-4 of the unit box they start in, measured 2026-10-28 (README "Validation"; legitimate reimplementations <= 1.3e-6 at n64000, the last position update skipped >= 2.1e-3)

outputs.name: vel
outputs.basis: not compared by upstream; the final velocities within 1e-4 of the input's max |v| (golden 0.02057 / 0.08552 / 0.41395 at n16000 / n32000 / n64000, rounded down), measured 2026-10-28 (README "Validation"; legitimate reimplementations <= 5.8e-6 of max |v|, fp16-rounded positions in the force >= 4.8e-4)

replaces.reason: nbody: the golden check now also compares the final particle state (pos, vel: 3 x n f32 each, copied from the device after the timed loop only when HPCPERF_GOLDEN_DUMP is set) and the kinetic-energy rule changes from upstream's max_abs 1e-3 (1 f32 ulp at n16000, bit equality at n32000/n64000: it failed 16/18/29 of 38 legitimate reimplementations and passed a skipped last position update, a mirrored state and a printed constant energy) to max_rel 1e-4; per-input rules pos max_abs 1e-4, vel max_abs 1e-4 x max|v| (2.0e-6 / 8.5e-6 / 4.1e-5).
